errors.evidence: The term '显著' (significantly) is a subjective interpretation. Furthermore, in Test5, the s-vector value (approx. 20%) is not significantly lower than i-vector (approx. 20.5%) and is tied with d-vector (approx. 20%).

This statement is factually incorrect. A lower WER is better. In Test2, d-vector (approx. 25%) is worse than i-vector and s-vector (both approx. 22.5%). In Test3, d-vector (approx. 25%) is the worst performer among all four methods.
